dct_creator_sm: Pandey, Neem (Department of Plant Agriculture. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph., University of Guelph).
dct_description_sm: As part of the "Soil health assessment and cover crops for the Holland Marsh" thesis research,  this experiment was conducted to assess the effect of seed priming on early emergence. Primed seeds of barley, oats and triticale were compared to non-primed seeds for early emergence, and biomass production.
dct_title_s: Soil health assessment and cover crops  for the Holland Marsh: Plug tray trial for seed priming assessment
